title: Gold Is Down 23%. Central Banks Just Bought 321 Tonnes #shorts
description:
Gold futures are about 23% below their January record. Yet in Q3 2026, central banks added 321 tonnes, up 42% from a year earlier, while jewelry demand fell 17% (the weakest third quarter on record) and bars and coins fell 19%.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: World Gold Council, Gold Demand Trends Q3 2026; Yahoo Finance GC=F.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
